## Summary

Describe the papers or resources added and why they belong in AI Infrastructure.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I checked `data/papers.yaml` and `data/rejected.yaml` for duplicates.
- [ ] Every paper makes a direct AI infrastructure or systems contribution.
- [ ] Publication and code links are stable and correctly attributed.
- [ ] Categories and venue names are consistent.
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_readme.py` was run.
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_readme.py --check` passes.
